content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The agreement's governing law is Arizona (p0043) — outside the accepted list — and Section 19 (p0053–p0056) routes all Disputes to mandatory binding arbitration rather than courts. Both points fail the fallback, so I flagged a deviation and proposed the preferred position:

1. **p0043** — "laws of the Arizona" → "laws of the State of New York" (element 1).
2. **p0056** — replaced the arbitration mandate and award-confirmation mechanic with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, preserving only a temporary injunctive relief carve-out (element 2).
3. **p0053** — renamed the retained heading from "Arbitration" to "Jurisdiction" so no dangling arbitration reference remains.

Unrelated text (severability, Disputes definition, signature block) was left verbatim.
